description: Run a tool a person made (tools.made-tool@1) on behalf of a person: X-OV-Subject (usr_) names the person the run is for; the run is paid from that person's allowance, Vibes or own keys, never the tool's maker or the calling service. POST /api/v1/made-tools/:id/run with { input } (answered with tools.run@1); a private tool runs only for its owner. GET /api/v1/made-tools lists the public tools, and with mine=1 the person's own (every visibility), for an agent's tool list. Without X-OV-Subject the token is refused (a made tool always runs as someone).
